title: PART SLOT CAR SET ETC
reason: Incomplete Tyco slot truck and track set with two trucks, controllers and accessories; modest collector interest.
findings: Fruit carton and a small box of HO slot car and play set parts that look like Tyco US-1 Electric Trucking items from the 1980s (a web search of that range lists a pipe loader, gravel hopper and green dump truck, but this is not confirmed against a box). Seen: a large quantity of black slotted track, grey straight, curved and lane change track with leads, a black box with leads (possibly a power pack), several orange and yellow hand controllers, plastic scenery including a Gravel Supply Company building and a brown loader labelled AMERICAN PIPE CO., a printed cardboard backdrop reading STAGE 2, a red box printed TYCO, a green dump truck and an orange and yellow truck cab on slot chassis, and a smaller box with loose cars (a white, red and blue number 29 stock car, a silver saloon, a blue and white car), yellow ramps and orange fences. Incomplete set as the title says.
condition: Used and dusty; some pieces look mixed from different sets; function of trucks, controllers and track untested.
rescore_note: Incomplete, mixed Tyco US-1 style slot truck set with two trucks, controllers, track and accessories; some collector interest, but untested, no box and pieces look mixed from different sets, so top of the $30 to 80 band. (no web price check)
